chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim, from Abd al-Rahman, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Abu Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
Whenever a slave strikes game while he is in ihram, then it is upon the master, if he had given him permission to enter ihram.

key_terms.إِحْرَامِهِ: his state of ihram for hajj or umrah
key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: If a slave hunts while in ihram, is the liability upon the slave or his master?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a slave who commits hunting-related violation while in ihram. It states that the liability falls upon the master if the master had permitted him to enter ihram.
